verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs pages are served as individual .md files (e.g., cards.md, introduction.md, velocity-controls.md), which is a lightweight agent-friendly format, but a root llms.txt aggregator returns 404 and no docs.md index or OpenAPI spec is discoverable. missing for 10: a valid llms.txt or docs.md manifest, an accessible machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger), and confirmation that an agent can be pointed at a single canonical entry point rather than individual page URLs.
